signals.title: Cafda Village, Retreat (Bernstein Rd, approx.): man, 41, shot dead, three young men wounded, 18 Oct
signals.content: Police say four people were shot on Bernstein Road near the Retreat Community Health Centre, in Cafda Village, on Sunday 18 October; police responded at about 15:30. A man of 41 died, and three young men aged 16 to 21 were wounded (Smile 90.4FM, quoting police spokesperson Wesley Twigg). Steenberg police are investigating murder and attempted murder cases. No motive and no arrest have been reported. The clinic was locked down after the shooting and reopened on 19 October (Department of Health and Wellness). The victims were not named. One report only.
